method: Identical input bytes converted repeatedly (soffice headless docx to pdf, one shared isolated profile per worker); each PDF projected to page count (pdfinfo), layout text (pdftotext -layout), and 36 dpi grayscale rasters (pdftoppm -gray); self-variance is the largest mean absolute pixel difference over all run pairs (see render-similarity.ts). One fixture per shape class: running prose, table grid, numbering part.
reason: Campaign 1 of 3 shows zero self-variance on convertible inputs, but promotion needs three consecutive campaigns under budget and currently fails the converter-coverage leg: the exporter crashes on 2 of 71 corpus fixtures (endnote-single, gallery-footnotes-endnotes; see the findings log), so a hard gate would red on renderer behavior, not engine behavior. Re-run two more campaigns on later dates; promote only if all three stay under budget with no open crashers.
